title: Loop engineering
summary: Loop engineering defines how an agent acts, checks feedback, and decides whether to continue.
overview: Here, the term means designing the repeated model-and-tool cycle. Each cycle needs observed results and a stopping rule.
why: Unchecked repetition can consume resources without making progress.
example: A repair agent edits code, runs a failing test, and stops after three unsuccessful attempts.
judgment: Choose measurable progress signals, iteration limits, and escalation conditions.
next: Which repeated tool failures should end the run immediately?
